clue.text: He and I, for example, in favour of sisters keeping nothing

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: the sisters keep, or hold inside them, the next piece

parts.note: nuns are religious sisters
O, the figure zero, is nothing

explanation.surface: A grammar point: 'He and I' presented as supporters of nuns who own nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' puts O inside NUNS, making NOUNS.
explanation.definitionFit: He and I are examples of personal pronouns, words standing in for nouns.

clue.text: Likewise, Conservative admires Greek philosopher

parts.note: so means likewise, in the same way
to rate someone is to admire or think highly of them

explanation.surface: A Tory is said to share an admiration for an ancient Greek thinker.
explanation.definitionFit: The Athenian thinker who taught Plato is the best-known Greek philosopher.

clue.text: Number touring notice pub, shabby in appearance

indicators.note: to tour is to go round, so the number goes around the next pieces

parts.note: three is a number
an ad is a notice, an advertisement
a bar is a pub

explanation.surface: A group touring with posters and pubs, looking worn out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' looks like a count of something, but here it is a specific number word that wraps round the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothes worn so thin the threads show look shabby; the word is a synonym for worn-out.

clue.text: Freshwater fish crossing river channel

indicators.note: the fish lies across, so around, the river letter

parts.note: a tench is a freshwater fish of the carp family

explanation.surface: A fish swimming across a river channel.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrow ditch cut in the ground is a channel, as in a drainage trench.

clue.text: King with deformed ear, seldom seen

parts.note: R, for Rex, is king

indicators.note: deformed means twisted out of shape, so the letters of ear change order

explanation.surface: A monarch with a misshapen ear is an unusual sight.
explanation.definitionFit: Something uncommon is seldom seen; the adjective is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Husband brought in a meek person to meet artist in palace

indicators.note: the husband is brought into the meek person

parts.note: a lamb is a gentle, meek person
RA, Royal Academician, is a crossword artist

explanation.surface: A husband introduces a timid person to a painter inside a royal residence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought in' puts H into LAMB, making LHAMB, after A.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alhambra in Granada is the famous Moorish palace and fortress in Spain.

clue.text: Smart, supporter at home — and away, ultimately

parts.note: a bra is a supporting garment
in means at home

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of away

explanation.surface: A clever fan, both at home games and away fixtures.
explanation.definitionFit: Being smart means clever, intelligent, which is to have plenty of brains.

clue.text: Outcome in Ypres, ultimately

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the words that follow, Ypres and ultimately

explanation.surface: How things turned out at the First World War battleground of Ypres in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the end of Ypres and the start of ultimately; 'ultimately' looks like a last-letter signal but is just part of the text.
explanation.definitionFit: A consequence or end product is an outcome; the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Nurse, not hot in shady garden alcove

indicators.note: not says the hot letter is to be left out

parts.note: to harbour is to nurse, as one nurses a grudge
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A nurse cooling off in a shady nook in the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: A bower of trees or climbing plants forming a shaded garden retreat.

clue.text: Before end of truce, tries again to go over

indicators.note: before says the court-case piece comes ahead of the next one

parts.note: a court rehears a case when it tries it again

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of truce

explanation.surface: Peace talks reopened before a ceasefire expires.
explanation.definitionFit: To practise or run through something again is to go over it.

clue.text: Charm one's way in

definitions.meaning: to charm or delight, with stress on the second syllable
a door or gateway by which one comes in

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to bewitch or delight; as a noun it is a doorway.

clue.text: Football League initially probing Premier club complaint?

indicators.note: probing means poking into, so the initials go inside the club

parts.note: Man U is short for Manchester United, a Premier League football club

indicators.note: initially takes the first letters of Football and League

explanation.surface: A grievance about lower-league football getting into a top club.
explanation.walkthrough: MAN FLU is a jokey British term for a mild cold that a man treats as serious, hence the question mark on 'complaint'.
explanation.definitionFit: An illness is a complaint, and this exaggerated cold is a tongue-in-cheek ailment.

clue.text: Exactly what's required, fair article by commission

parts.note: just means fair
the is the definite article
a job is a commission, a piece of work ordered

explanation.surface: A fair-sounding contract that is precisely what was needed.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for something perfectly suited to the purpose.

clue.text: Boy appearing after James

indicators.note: after puts the appearing piece behind the name

parts.note: on means appearing, as a performer is on stage

explanation.surface: One lad takes the stage following another named James.
explanation.definitionFit: A common boy's name; crosswords use boy for any male first name.

clue.text: South American, extremely sensitive, explains barking dog

parts.note: US means American

indicators.note: extremely takes the outside letters of sensitive
barking means mad, so the letters of explains go wild

explanation.surface: A touchy South American explains why his dog is barking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barking' rearranges EXPLAINS into XSPANIEL. Sussex is a county in southern England.
explanation.definitionFit: A breed of gundog from Sussex, a short-legged golden-liver spaniel.

clue.text: Inspected fabric cut up

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: denim is a cotton fabric
to axe is to cut

explanation.surface: Someone checked over a piece of cloth that had been cut to pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns DENIMAXE around to read from the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: To have looked at something closely is to have inspected it.

clue.text: I will remedy abuse

parts.note: I'll is the contraction of I will
to treat is to remedy or cure

explanation.surface: Someone vows to put right a wrong done.
explanation.definitionFit: To abuse someone is to handle them cruelly, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Idler having answer in amateur contest

indicators.note: in places the answer letter within the amateur contest

parts.note: lay means amateur, non-professional
a bout is a contest, as in boxing

explanation.surface: A lazy person entering an amateur match.
explanation.definitionFit: A lazy, work-shy person who idles about is an idler.

clue.text: Sophisticated former pope, last to pontificate

parts.note: Urban is the name of eight popes

indicators.note: last to picks the final letter of pontificate

explanation.surface: A worldly ex-pontiff gets the final word in pontificating.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone suave and polished in manner is sophisticated.

clue.text: Diligent American leaving for workshop

indicators.note: leaving says the American letters go out of the word

parts.note: studious means diligent
US means American

explanation.surface: A hard-working American departs for a craft session.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's or craftsman's workroom is a workshop.

clue.text: Awful baloney about one beheaded knight and queen

indicators.note: about means around, so the shuffled letters surround the rest
awful says the letters of baloney are made a mess of

parts.note: N is knight in chess notation

indicators.note: beheaded takes off the first letter of one

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Nonsense about a decapitated knight and a queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awful' rearranges the letters of baloney; 'about' wraps that jumble around the knight and the headless one, sitting just after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry VIII's second wife, an English queen famously executed.

clue.text: Bird spotted by black dog

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
an eagle is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A bird of prey sighted next to a black dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A small hound breed used for hunting hares, a type of dog.

clue.text: Expert came across, over for the time being

parts.note: a pro is an expert

indicators.note: over says the met piece is turned back to front

parts.note: met means came across, encountered

explanation.surface: A specialist encountered someone, though only temporarily.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin pro tempore, used in English for temporarily, for now.

clue.text: Face endless people giving a torrent of abuse

indicators.note: endless says the final letter of the face word goes

parts.note: a dial is a face, as of a clock, and slang for a person's face
a tribe is a people

explanation.surface: Facing a crowd that never stops hurling insults.
explanation.definitionFit: A long, bitter verbal attack is a torrent of abuse; the word is a near synonym.

clue.text: Information — a little sent over

indicators.note: sent over means turned over, so the letters are read backwards

parts.note: a tad means a little

explanation.surface: A small amount of intelligence dispatched to someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Facts and figures, items of information, are data.

clue.text: Prepared drainage for shrub

indicators.note: prepared means made ready or worked up, so the letters of drainage are rearranged

explanation.surface: Getting the soil drainage ready before planting a bush.
explanation.definitionFit: An evergreen flowering bush with fragrant white blooms, a type of shrub.

clue.text: Prelude to show at university

parts.note: to lead is to show the way
up means at university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: The overture to a student production.
explanation.definitionFit: The period or events preceding something form its prelude.

clue.text: Poor speed by back

indicators.note: by places the speed word next to the back word

parts.note: to second is to back or support, as a motion
rate means speed

explanation.surface: A weak pace set by a defender.
explanation.definitionFit: Inferior or mediocre quality is poor; the hyphenated adjective is a synonym.
